title: Tensor of the termwise scalar comparison on a summand
statement: For a finite commutative ring R, a scheme morphism p:X→Y, cochain complexes P,Q of fixed scalar sheaves and a+b=n, the (a,b) injection into the tensor total of realized fixed pullbacks, followed by the tensor total map of the two complex scalar comparisons, equals the ordinary tensor of their scalar comparison components at P.X a and Q.X b followed by the target injection into the tensor total of intrinsic pullbacks of the realized complexes.

proof.text: Expand the uncurried total tensor map as mapBifunctorMap. Apply Mathlib HomologicalComplex.ι_mapBifunctorMap, replace each degree component by the ordinary scalar comparison using mapHomologicalComplexCompIso_inv_app_f, expand the ordinary uncurried tensor map, and reassociate. The remaining equality is definitional. This entire calculation is proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarTensorPullback_comparison_map_summand
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ)
    (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n) :
    CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor
      (((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P))
      (((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
      (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)) a b n h ≫
      (((uncurry.obj
        ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)).map₂HomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))).map
            (Prod.mkHom ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app P)
              ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app Q))).f n) =
    ((uncurry.obj (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X (proEtaleConstantRing X R))).map
      (Prod.mkHom ((finiteScalarOrdinaryPullbackComparison R p).inv.app (P.X a))
        ((finiteScalarOrdinaryPullbackComparison R p).inv.app (Q.X b)))) ≫
    CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor
      (((proEtaleRingModulePullback p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)
        (proEtaleConstantRing X R) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj (((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P))
      (((proEtaleRingModulePullback p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)
        (proEtaleConstantRing X R) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj (((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Y R).functor.mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)) a b n h
